t: A six lesson unit where students log sensor data with micro:bits and build a dashboard.
steps: Register for Day of AI to view the resources.
Obtain micro:bits, with V2 or newer working best, and environmental sensors.
Prepare a phone or tablet that can run the App Inventor app.
Decide which Google account students will use for Sheets.
Review what data goes to Google Sheets with your school.
Run the first lesson yourself before teaching it.
